mechanism: Escitalopram (SSRI) increases serotonin levels and may potentiate sacubitril's vasodilatory effects, with additive risk of hypotension and potential serotonin syndrome; sacubitril/valsartan also increases bradykinin which may interact with serotonergic pathways.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia), and ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment if hypotension develops.
